title: Identity providers and login policy
purpose: Test organization authentication routes and trust contracts, verify recovery paths, then activate.

actions.label: Diagnose connection
actions.effect: Return error, version and trust validation results

actions.label: Test login
actions.effect: Assess identity and MFA; not business approval

actions.label: Request policy activation
actions.precondition: Diagnostics, recovery and enforced SSO verified
actions.effect: Plan activation of a new revision through the trust workflow
actions.confirmation: Confirm affected users and lockout risk

actions.label: Plan key rotation
actions.precondition: Old and new key validity and verification

actions.label: Recheck external status
actions.permission: Diagnostic permission for this authentication connection
actions.precondition: Allowed adapter, scope and destination with current connection authority
actions.effect: Requery and reconcile external inactivity and group changes; update successful evidence and last-success time; retain sensitive-command hold while unknown

actions.label: Propose trust change
actions.precondition: Current connection revision and expected old epoch; exact proposal and proof references
actions.effect: Create a draft proposal only; active trust unchanged
actions.confirmation: Review proposed scope and old/new digests

actions.label: Validate trust change
actions.precondition: Draft proposal at expected revision; exact configuration, proof and old epoch
actions.effect: Record validated or blocked evidence; no approval or activation

actions.label: Independently approve trust change
actions.permission: Scoped trust.approve by an independent authorized actor
actions.precondition: Validated proposal at expected revision and digest; current old epoch; approver differs from proposer
actions.effect: Record independent approval of the exact proposal; active trust unchanged
actions.confirmation: Confirm exact digest, authority and session/lockout impact

actions.label: Activate approved trust change
actions.permission: Scoped trust.activate plus current independent approved authority
actions.precondition: Independently approved revision/digest; expected old epoch; current proposer/approver separation and approver/activator authority
actions.effect: Atomically publish configuration, strictly newer epoch and durable invalidation intent; report propagation separately
actions.confirmation: Confirm approved digest, affected principals and session/lockout impact

actions.label: Reject trust change
actions.precondition: Current proposal revision and rationale; before activation
actions.effect: Mark proposal rejected; active trust unchanged

actions.label: Cancel trust proposal
actions.precondition: Current proposal revision and rationale; before activation
actions.effect: Mark proposal cancelled; active trust unchanged

sections.title: Method selection on the left
content: Distinguish direct LDAP from federated SSO.

sections.title: Trust inputs in the center
content: Method-specific conditional fields; never expose plaintext secrets in lists.

sections.title: Tests and recovery on the right
content: Assess subject, MFA and permissions separately; authentication failures must not disclose account existence.

sections.title: External-status verification and detection delay
content: Show per-connection event/synchronization/polling method, last attempt, last success, next check, maximum delay and failure reason. Check intervals and delay values are unset; do not invent defaults.

Unknown external status holds sensitive commands. A recheck receipt or ordinary successful login does not release the hold; evidence must verify current inactivity, groups and scope. Product-local suspension blocks from the next permission check.

sections.title: Trust change
content: The proposed [command contract](../../../contracts/commands/planning-actions.md) uses `trust.propose`, `trust.validate`, `trust.approve`, `trust.activate`, `trust.reject` and `trust.cancel`. These are planning IDs, not deployed APIs. Existing diagnostic, test-login, activation-request, key-rotation and external-status actions remain, but activation must use this governed transition rather than a generic bypass.

A proposal binds workspace/provider route, expected old trust epoch and revision, old/new configuration digests, issuer/stable subject/identity binding, verified identity/MFA proof, diagnostics, recovery evidence, current external identity status, session impact and affected subjects. Show changes and lockout/revocation consequences before submission. States are `draft → validated → independently_approved → activated`, with explicit rejected/cancelled outcomes. Changing the candidate or bound evidence invalidates validation and approval. Verified provider key rotation under an unchanged trust root remains a separate validated rotation. Changes to the trust root, issuer or identity namespace, or weakened MFA, require this independent trust workflow; rollback is a new independently approved change with a strictly newer epoch, never resurrection of an old epoch or revoked grant.

Proposer, approver and activator have distinct rights. Self-approval is prohibited. Activation requires an independently approved proposal and an authorized activation actor whose current authority is rechecked against the old epoch at execution. A matching role name, successful test login or possession of the proposed new identity cannot confer approval or activate its own authority. Missing independent approval, stale epochs, unknown external identity status, failed recovery or insufficient current privileges block activation. An emergency policy remains separately unresolved; no generic recovery bypass is introduced.

Activation compares the old epoch/revision and atomically commits the new epoch with durable invalidation intent for affected sessions, credentials and cached permissions. Display invalidation progress and any unknown completion; do not claim all sessions revoked from acceptance alone. Concurrent proposals cannot both activate against the same old epoch. Idempotent retry rechecks present authorization before revealing prior protected results; mismatched payload conflicts. Stale evidence requires a fresh proposal/review, not silent rebasing. Reject/cancel are legal only before activation and retain reasons and history without mutating active trust.

Acceptance (NOT_RUN): reject self-approval, replay from old epochs and simultaneous activation; candidate mutation invalidates approval; revoked approver/activator is rechecked; timeout does not imply activation or completed invalidation; rollback gets a newer epoch; external unknown retains the sensitive-command hold.

states.name: loading
states.message: Checking scope and permissions and loading Identity providers and login policy.

states.name: empty
states.message: No items match the current permitted scope and filters. Check scope and filters.

states.name: partial
states.message: Only part of the data or work is ready. Show ready, missing, held, failed and unprocessed scopes separately; this is not full completion or zero.

states.name: blocked
states.message: Test login or recovery path is unverified. Hold policy activation.

states.name: error
states.message: Provider connection failed. Do not disable TLS validation or automatically switch to another login method.

states.name: revoked
states.message: Access to this scope has changed. Remove sensitive details, previews and selections, stop affected actions and downloads, and query permitted scope again. Recall of externally delivered copies is not guaranteed.

states.name: external_status_unknown
states.message: External account status is unknown. Sensitive commands remain held; request a status recheck.

states.name: sync_failed
states.message: External status synchronization failed. Check the last success and delay; do not assume the account is active.

states.name: draft
states.message: Trust change is a draft; active trust is unchanged.

states.name: validated
states.message: Exact proposal evidence is validated; independent approval is required.

states.name: independently_approved
states.message: Independent approval is recorded; activation still rechecks current authority and old epoch.

states.name: activated
states.message: The new epoch and invalidation intent are committed. Inspect remaining invalidation progress.

states.name: rejected
states.message: The proposal is rejected; active trust is unchanged.

states.name: cancelled
states.message: The proposal is cancelled; active trust is unchanged.
